svg.title: Handshake cost per scenario
svg.desc: ECDHE P-256 + RSA-2048 (legacy): wall 2.13 ms, client CPU 1.10 ms, server CPU 1.00 ms; X25519 + ECDSA P-256: wall 1.59 ms, client CPU 0.82 ms, server CPU 0.76 ms; X25519MLKEM768 + ECDSA P-256: wall 1.87 ms, client CPU 1.00 ms, server CPU 0.86 ms; X25519MLKEM768 + ML-DSA-65: wall 5.23 ms, client CPU 2.54 ms, server CPU 2.31 ms; ML-KEM-768 + ML-DSA-65 (pure PQC): wall 4.43 ms, client CPU 2.23 ms, server CPU 1.87 ms; SecP384r1MLKEM1024 + ML-DSA-87 (CNSA 2.0 level): wall 7.88 ms, client CPU 3.79 ms, server CPU 3.49 ms
